create_VocabParallelEmbeddingWithLoRA: create a VocabParallelEmbeddingWithLoRA layer wrapping a base VocabParallelEmbedding for LoRA-adapted embedding
build_create_lora_weights: build LoRA weight tensors (lora_a_stacked, lora_b_stacked) for a vocab parallel embedding layer with given max_loras and rank
test_set_lora: test setting LoRA adapter weights (lora_a, lora_b) into a stacked buffer at a given index with transpose handling
run_forward_with_lora: run forward pass on input tokens through vocab parallel embedding with LoRA embedding and adapter output added
review_can_replace_layer: review whether a source layer can be replaced by VocabParallelEmbeddingWithLoRA based on type matching
